versions.content: When the RAM check fails on wakeup (see section 7.5.2 Activities in the Halt Sequence) the ECU Manager module shall invoke EcuM_ErrorHook with the parameter ECUM_E_RAM_CHECK_FAILED. It is left integrator’s discretion to allow EcuM_ErrorHook to relay the error to the DEM when he judges that the DEM will not write damaged NVRAM blocks.
